thread:
Priya: Heads up — candidate JZ moved to remote onsite tomorrow 11:00 PST. Need a scribe, confirm debrief anchors, and a tiny change to the interviewer kit (consent checkbox + auto-fill candidate id). Who can scribe? :raised_hands:
Samir Patel: I can scribe the 11:00 slot. happy to handle debrief notes. :+1:
Elena: I’m on the panel but will be finishing another interview at 11:00 — can join at 11:10. Samir, can you cover the intro and transitions?
Maya K: @Priya fyi I opened a small PR to add the consent checkbox and candidateId auto-fill to the debrief form. Link: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4782 :eyes:
Leah: quick verification — do we want the checkbox text to be exactly: "Candidate consents to recording and debrief notes"? also i sketched an auto-fill snippet below that matches our current frontend form keys:
```
// patch for debrief form
if (candidateId) {
  form.values.candidate_id = candidateId;
}
form.values.recording_consent = false; // user must opt in
```
Johnson: assigning myself to review the PR now. if folks want specific copy tweaks, add inline comments.
Devex Bot: PR 4782 created by maya_k. CI: pending. reviewers: @Johnson.
Priya: thanks all. Samir — can you also flag any rubric edge-cases in the notes (esp. system-design timeboxing and takehome vs live question split)? put short bullets under "observations" in the form.
Samir Patel: will do. i'll capture: timebox exceeded by 4m, candidate pivoted to tradeoffs rather than perf numbers, followup takehome recommended.
Elena: for system design I suggested the rubric weight: architecture 40%, tradeoffs 30%, communication 20%, constraints 10%. if you want i can paste into the debrief template.
Priya: please paste that. also adding to calendar invite: "Recording consent asked at start; scribe = Samir Patel; panel arrival by 10:55."
Maya K: CI passed on PR, small lint fix pushed. ready for review.
Johnson: left two tiny comments on copy and one accessibility note. nothing blocking. requesting @Leah for wording on the consent line.
Leah: updated wording suggestion in PR comment — slightly shorter: "I consent to recording and notes for debrief."
Priya: perfect. once PR is merged, Samir — can you use the updated form for the debrief and tag me in the doc?
Samir Patel: yep. will tag and upload within 30m after interview.
Devex Bot: PR 4782 merged by maya_k at 1732110255.
Priya: great — thanks everyone. small followup: Samir, if you notice any flakiness in the video recording setup, ping eng-infra.
Samir Patel: noted.
Priya: closing loop. :white_check_mark:
